metadata.request_count_semantics: Observed request counts; delivery completeness is not guaranteed.

request_coverage.zero_inference: Absent metric inferred zero only when positive method activity exists, all metric reads succeed, and observed operation counts sum to AllRequests.

limitations: CloudTrail delivery has no guaranteed completion time; calibration and quiet logs do not prove exact counts.

Counts include recorded retries and deduplicate eventID. UTC windows widen to full seconds because CloudTrail eventTime lacks subsecond precision; the runner must separate setup and verification reads from these bounds.
